findings.title: Preserve right alignment in the legacy flexbox fallback
findings.body: The new `flexbox()` mixin explicitly falls back to `display: -webkit-box`, but that older layout model does not distribute free space through auto margins. On browsers using this fallback (such as the Android 4.x stock browser), removing `float: right` and relying on `margin-left: auto` leaves the header panel immediately beside the logo/topic information instead of against the right edge. Provide a compatible flexible spacer or retain a working fallback layout for these browsers.
